sections.text: Introduction

This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I1 for generator air circuit breakers, which must be performed 
every every 3 years as indicated by Y3 in the title block.
The technical data of the circuit breaker:

Air circuit breaker rated voltage 17.5 
kv rated current 5000 A and rated braking capacity 40 kA

This 
breakers associated type GM electrical stored energy operating mecanism supplied 
at 110 Vdc, shunt closing release 110 Vdc and shunt voltage operating 
release .

The 
first draft is initiated and tested by eng. Mamdouh Aly Hassan, accepted by eng. 
Mahmoud Ahmed Abd El Dayem general manager, approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel-Baset 
head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb 
Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control general director.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
